title: Tech Note: 4D Write to 4D Write Pro Conversion Guidelines: Form and Off-screen areas
author: Hamza Aharbil, Quality Support Engineer, 4D Morocco.
featured_technology: WP New / WP Print / ST COMPUTE EXPRESSIONS

historical_commentary.text: This is a migration guide for moving off the legacy 32-bit 4D Write plugin onto 4D Write Pro; today 4D Write classic is long discontinued/unsupported and virtually all remaining 4D Write databases should already have migrated, making this note now primarily of historical/archival interest for anyone still holding very old databases.
related_updates: 4D Write classic (WR commands, external plugin) was removed from 64-bit 4D entirely; 4D Write Pro (WP/ST commands) has been the only supported word-processing engine in 4D for many years
4D Write Pro itself has continued to evolve substantially since v17/v18 with a modern object-based document model, HTML/CSS-influenced styling, and deeper ORDA/forms integration
